question: On which of the following days is World Computer Literacy Day observed?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2 December.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Computer Literacy Day** is observed on **2 December** every year to **create awareness about the growing use and importance of computers.**
 
• It was **first observed in 2001** on the occasion of the **20th anniversary** of the renowned Indian computer company, National Institute of Information Technology (NIIT).
 
• The theme for 2021 is **"Literacy for human-centered recovery: Narrowing the digital divide".​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Environment Day** is celebrated every year on **June 5** to raise awareness and generate action on a pressing environmental issue.
 
• **May 13th** is celebrated as International Hummus Day.
 
• **30th September** is celebrated as International Translation Day.
